title: Interesting Experience Of A Gaudi Design
text: Visiting La Pedrera was much more interesting than expected.  It was fun to be up on the roof however the attic area was even more interesting.  The organization that runs La Pedrera has created an interesting experience which is supported with an informative audio guide.  The gift shop had high quality choices.  It was easy to get to on the metro and is located in the designer shopping area along a  beautiful boulevard.
author: KJC1960

title: Stunning Gaudi work
text: This was a self-directed tour of Gaudi's famous architectural work of an apartment complex in Barcelona.  Audio was provided and we toured at our own pace.
author: Gasper_N

title: Casa Mila
text: This is such a beautiful and fascinating building. It’s a simple self-guided tour. The view from the roof is lovely.
author: Alison_G

title: A Goudi classic, incredible to believe this 45000 square foot property was built for a couple
text: Not a big place in terms of the visitor ‘essentials’ route but worthwhile. Great audio guide that sensed your location around the building and triggered automatically…neat.  The apartment and roof terrace areas were great….but the Star is the architecture
author: CHD6265

title: Amazing place
text: The audio guide works well for both kids and adults. It’s well paced and interesting. You can decide how long you want to spend in each area of the house.
author: Jo_S

title: Gaudi self audio tour
text: This was self audio tour it was fabulous as we could takenour time and listen to the tour on the phone.
author: tasnim_k

title: Great audioguide,...
text: Great audioguide, interesting building, great views of the city. That's all I've got for your review.
author: John_P

title: Go at your own pace.
text: Loved the audio tour. Go at your own pace… no guide to rush you through. Highly recommend! Well organized and prompt tour company.
author: Lauren_B

title: A Gaudi experience.
text: In a previous trip to Barcelona, we only saw from the outside. It was great to see what it looked like inside with some original pieces of furniture. The rooftop views were spectacular.  The audio guide was very helpful. If you are a Gaudi fan, then this is a must see.
author: Amado_E

title: Excellent. Rained during...
text: Excellent. Rained during our visit so the roof was closed which was a disappointment. Worth the visit.
author: Richard_L
